verdict.rationale: Benchmark Email's API page documents per-key, per-resource permissions (No Access, Read, or Read & Write across contacts, campaigns, reports and domains), plus optional per-key expiration and deactivation. Together these let a user issue a least-privilege, time-bound credential for an agent. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, finer-grained scoping beyond the four resource categories (e.g., per-list or per-action), and in-depth reference docs, since the evidence is marketing-page level and no OpenAPI spec was found.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: Per-resource permissions: No Access, Read, or Read & Write (contacts, campaigns, reports, domains)
Optional expiration dates per key; deactivate and reactivate without rotating
Read-only access to the verification status of your private sending domains.
